args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (~18%) following the v2.3.1 release to production. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release with a healthy production history. Rollback verified: health checks passing and error rate back to ~0.2%. Follow-up needed to investigate the v2.3.1 regression before re-deploying.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent release with a healthy production history was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rollback**: Rolled back all three regions to v2.3.0 — verified recovery with health checks passing and error rate back down to ~0.2%. No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 had been healthy in production.
- **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0") with a description of the diagnosis, the rollback, and follow-up to investigate the v2.3.1 regression. The on-call engineer has been paged.
